# Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
> The CDC is the U.S. public health agency providing authoritative guidance on diseases, prevention, outbreaks, data, and health promotion.

CDC.gov serves the public, healthcare professionals, researchers, laboratories, and public health agencies with evidence-based information on infectious diseases, chronic conditions, vaccination, emergency response, scientific publications, and agency programs.

## Core Navigation
- [CDC Home](https://www.cdc.gov/): Main portal for CDC health guidance, featured topics, news, and public health resources.
- [Health Topics](https://www.cdc.gov/health-topics.html): A-to-Z directory of diseases, conditions, wellness topics, and prevention information.
- [Outbreaks](https://www.cdc.gov/outbreaks/index.html): Current outbreak investigations, response updates, and public health notices.
- [About CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/about/): Agency mission, organization, leadership, priorities, and operational information.
- [CDC en Español](https://www.cdc.gov/spanish/): Spanish-language CDC portal with translated health information and guidance.
- [CDC Newsroom](https://www.cdc.gov/media/): Press releases, media statements, briefings, and communication resources.
- [CDC-INFO Contact Center](https://www.cdc.gov/cdc-info/index.html): Public contact information, answers, and support channels for CDC inquiries.

## Infectious Diseases
- [COVID-19 Prevention](https://www.cdc.gov/covid/prevention/index.html): Guidance on reducing COVID-19 risk through prevention and protective actions.
- [Flu Signs and Symptoms](https://www.cdc.gov/flu/signs-symptoms/index.html): Influenza symptoms, complications, and when to seek medical care.
- [H5 Bird Flu Signs and Symptoms](https://www.cdc.gov/bird-flu/signs-symptoms/index.html): Symptoms of avian influenza in people and related health guidance.
- [Measles Overview](https://www.cdc.gov/measles/about/index.html): Measles basics, spread, symptoms, complications, and prevention.
- [Lyme Disease Overview](https://www.cdc.gov/lyme/about/index.html): Tick-borne Lyme disease information, symptoms, and prevention basics.
- [Hantavirus Overview](https://www.cdc.gov/hantavirus/about/index.html): Hantavirus transmission, symptoms, and disease overview.
- [Dengue Prevention](https://www.cdc.gov/dengue/prevention/): Mosquito bite prevention and actions to reduce dengue risk.

## Vaccines and Immunization
- [Adult Vaccinations](https://www.cdc.gov/vaccines-adults/recommended-vaccines/index.html): Recommended vaccines for adults by age, risk, and health status.
- [Measles Overview](https://www.cdc.gov/measles/about/index.html): Measles disease information supporting vaccination and prevention decisions.
- [COVID-19 Prevention](https://www.cdc.gov/covid/prevention/index.html): Prevention guidance including vaccination as part of layered protection.
- [Flu Signs and Symptoms](https://www.cdc.gov/flu/signs-symptoms/index.html): Influenza information relevant to seasonal vaccination and clinical awareness.

## Chronic Diseases and Health Promotion
- [Alzheimer’s Disease Overview](https://www.cdc.gov/alzheimers-dementia/about/alzheimers.html): Information on Alzheimer’s disease and public health impact.
- [Type 2 Diabetes Prevention](https://www.cdc.gov/diabetes/prevention-type-2/index.html): Steps to lower risk for type 2 diabetes through prevention.
- [Healthy Weight Tips](https://www.cdc.gov/healthy-weight-growth/about/tips-for-balancing-food-activity.html): Practical guidance for balancing food intake and physical activity.
- [High Blood Pressure Overview](https://www.cdc.gov/high-blood-pressure/about/index.html): Basics of hypertension, risks, and prevention information.
- [Overdose Prevention](https://www.cdc.gov/overdose-prevention/prevention/index.html): Strategies to prevent drug overdose and reduce harm.

## Hygiene and Prevention
- [Handwashing Facts and Stats](https://www.cdc.gov/clean-hands/data-research/facts-stats/): Evidence and statistics on hand hygiene and disease prevention.
- [Dengue Prevention](https://www.cdc.gov/dengue/prevention/): Personal and community actions to prevent mosquito-borne infection.
- [COVID-19 Prevention](https://www.cdc.gov/covid/prevention/index.html): Everyday prevention actions for respiratory disease risk reduction.
- [Type 2 Diabetes Prevention](https://www.cdc.gov/diabetes/prevention-type-2/index.html): Lifestyle prevention guidance for long-term health improvement.

## Science, Research, and Publications
- [Scientific Journals](https://www.cdc.gov/journals/): CDC scientific journals and publication platforms for public health research.
- [Science at CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/science/): CDC scientific work, research priorities, and evidence-based public health activities.
- [Lab Safety](https://www.cdc.gov/labs/strong-lab-safety/): Laboratory safety principles, culture, and CDC safety initiatives.
- [CDC Museum](https://www.cdc.gov/museum/): Historical and educational resources on CDC science and public health work.

## Agency Information
- [About CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/about/): Overview of CDC’s role, mission, and public health responsibilities.
- [Organization](https://www.cdc.gov/about/organization/): CDC organizational structure, centers, institutes, and offices.
- [Leadership](https://www.cdc.gov/about/leadership/): Senior leadership information and agency leadership roles.
- [Budget](https://www.cdc.gov/budget/): Budget, funding priorities, and financial information for CDC programs.
- [Pressroom](https://www.cdc.gov/media/): Media resources, announcements, and official CDC communications.

## Careers, Training, and Funding
- [Careers at CDC](https://jobs.cdc.gov/index.html): Employment opportunities, job categories, and hiring information.
- [Fellowships and Training](https://www.cdc.gov/fellowships/php/index.html): Training, fellowship, and professional development opportunities in public health.
- [Funding and Grants](https://www.cdc.gov/budget/): Budget and funding information relevant to CDC-supported programs.
- [CDC Museum](https://www.cdc.gov/museum/): Educational programs and exhibits related to CDC history and public health.

## Public Communication and Support
- [CDC-INFO](https://www.cdc.gov/cdc-info/index.html): Central contact resource for public questions and CDC information requests.
- [Contact CDC](https://www.cdc.gov/cdc-info/index.html): Official contact pathways for CDC services and information.
- [CDC Newsroom](https://www.cdc.gov/media/): News releases and media materials on current public health issues.
- [Outbreaks](https://www.cdc.gov/outbreaks/index.html): Timely outbreak updates for the public and health professionals.
